note: The fifth check of scripts/check-lint-deps.py, M1-135 (register decisions 662, 665, 667 and 668): every file of the repository a tree compiles is linted or named in ORBSIM_LINT_EXCEPTIONS with its reason. Each mutant switches off one of the check's refusals; the judges are its self-test and the real check against this tree. The outside-the-repository mutant drops the report and keeps the `continue`: dropping the whole branch would leave the file to be reported as unlinted, so the self-test would catch it for another reason. The first seven are expected to be caught by the self-test alone, since the real tree holds none of those faults; the eighth, which stops passing over the folders a tree's CMakeCache.txt names as fetched code (decision 672), by the self-test and, in a tree pointed at a dependency cache outside the repository, by lint_deps too.
